title: Memory Mania
about:
Round -01 : MATCHING THE CARDS

Objective

The objective of the game is to test the participant’s memory, concentration, and observation skills by identifying and matching pairs of identical cards within the given time limit.

Game Setup

  • A total of 20 cards will be placed face-down on the table in a predefined arrangement.
  • The cards will be thoroughly shuffled before the game begins.
  • Each card will have a matching pair, resulting in 10 pairs in total.
  • All cards must remain face-down, and participants must not be able to see the patterns before making their selection.
rules:
1. Each participant will be given a fixed time limit to complete the game.
  2. At the start of the game, all 20 cards will be placed face-down.
  3. The participant must select any two cards at a time and turn them over to reveal their patterns.
  4. If the two cards match, the pair will be considered successfully matched and will be removed/kept aside as decided by the organizers.
  5. If the two cards do not match, they must be turned face-down again before the participant proceeds with the next attempt.
  6. Participants must rely on their memory and observation to remember the positions of previously revealed cards.
  7. Participants are not allowed to move, shuffle, or change the position of any card.
  8. Only two cards may be turned over at a time.
  9. Participants must not receive assistance or hints from other participants or spectators.
  10. The game will end when:
    • The allotted time expires, or
    • All pairs have been successfully matched, whichever occurs first.
  11. The number of correctly matched pairs will be recorded as the participant’s score.

Scoring & Qualification

  • 1 successfully matched pair = 1 point.
  • Participants will be ranked according to the number of pairs matched within the given time limit
  • Participants with the highest scores will qualify for the next round.
  • The number of participants qualifying for the next round will be decided by the organizers based on the total number of participants.

Tie-Breaker

In case two or more participants obtain the same score, a tie-breaker round may be conducted by the organizers.

Disqualification

A participant may be disqualified for:

  • Peeking at the cards before the game begins.
  • Intentionally changing or disturbing the position of the cards.
  • Taking assistance or hints from others.
  • Turning over more than two cards at a time.
  • Engaging in any unfair practice or violating the instructions given by the organizers.

Final Decision

The decision of the game coordinator/judges will be final and binding in case of any dispute or ambiguity.

Round-02: ANALYSE THE IMAGE & SOLVE THE CROSSWORD

Objective

The objective of the game is to test the participant’s observation, memory, concentration, recall, and analytical skills by carefully studying an image and using the information remembered from it to solve a crossword puzzle.

Game Setup

  • Each participant will be provided with access to a laptop/computer screen.
  • A specific image containing multiple identifiable elements will be displayed on the screen.
  • The image will be displayed for 30 seconds only.
  • After 30 seconds, the image/screens will be turned off or the image will be removed from the participants' view.
  • A crossword puzzle will then be provided to each participant.
  • The clues/questions in the crossword will be based on the objects, elements, people, places, symbols, or other details present in the displayed image.

How to Play

  1. The image will be displayed on the participant’s screen for 30 seconds.
  2. Participants must carefully observe and remember as many elements of the image as possible during this time.
  3. Participants may not write down any information while the image is being displayed.
  4. Once the 30 seconds are over, the image will no longer be visible.
  5. The crossword puzzle will then be provided to the participants.
  6. Each crossword clue will relate to an element that was present in the displayed image.
  7. Participants must use their memory and understanding of the image to identify the correct answers.
  8. The answers must be entered in the appropriate boxes of the crossword puzzle.
  9. Participants must complete the crossword within the given time limit.
  10. The completed crossword must be submitted to the event coordinator before the time limit expires.
    • Participants will get only 30 seconds to observe the image.
    • The image will be displayed only once and will not be shown again during the round.
    • Participants are not permitted to take photographs, screenshots, or recordings of the image.
    • Participants are not allowed to use their phones, the internet, or any external source of information.
    • No notes or rough work related to the image may be written while the image is being displayed.
    • Once the image is removed, participants must rely solely on their memory to solve the crossword.
    • Participants must not communicate or discuss answers with other participants.
    • Any form of assistance, prompting, or discussion with other participants will be considered a violation of the rules.
    • Only answers that fit the given clues and crossword structure will be considered valid.
    • Spelling must be correct. Incorrectly spelled answers will not receive marks.
    • The crossword must be completed and submitted within the specified time limit.

Scoring

  • 1 correct answer = 1 point.
  • Points will be awarded only for correctly answered crossword clues.
  • No negative marking will be applied for incorrect answers.
  • The participant with the highest score will be ranked highest in the round.

Qualification

Depending on the number of participants, the organizers will decide the number of participants who will proceed to the next round.

Participants will be shortlisted based on their total score and/or completion time, as decided by the organizers before the event.

Tie-Breaker

In case of a tie between participants:

  • A short additional memory-based question/puzzle may be given as a tie-breaker.
  • The participant who scores higher in the tie-breaker will qualify.
  • If required, the organizers may conduct additional tie-breakers until the tie is resolved.

Disqualification

A participant may be disqualified for:

  • Using a mobile phone, internet, or any unauthorized electronic device.
  • Taking a photograph or screenshot of the displayed image.
  • Writing notes while the image is being displayed.
  • Receiving or providing assistance to another participant.
  • Discussing answers during the game.
  • Attempting to access the image after the observation period has ended.
  • Any other unfair practice as determined by the organizers.

Final Decision

The decision of the game coordinator/judges will be final and binding in case of any dispute, ambiguity, or technical issue during the game.

Round-03: GUESS THE PASSCODE

Objective

The objective of the game is to test the participant’s memory, concentration, observation, recall, logical thinking, and word-solving ability.

Participants must memorize the letters associated with different symbols and later use their memory to identify a hidden word from a given sequence of symbols.

Game Setup

  • A set of symbols will be displayed on the screen.
  • Each symbol will be assigned a specific letter.
  • Participants will be given 1 minute to observe and memorize the symbol–letter associations.
  • After 1 minute, the symbols and their corresponding letters will be removed from the screen.
  • Participants will then receive a case/problem statement.
  • The statement will contain the names of different symbols from the memorization phase in a particular sequence.
  • Participants must identify the symbols mentioned in the statement and recall the letter associated with each symbol.
  • The resulting letters will form a jumbled word.
  • Participants must rearrange the letters and identify the correct meaningful word.

Example Memorization Phase

Participants are shown:

Symbol

Letter

⭐ Star

T

🔺 Triangle

H

● Circle

I

❤️Heart

N

  • Diamond

K

The participants get 1 minute to memorize the associations. The display is then removed.

Problem Statement

The participant receives a statement such as:

"During the activity, the Heart, Star, Circle, Diamond and Triangle were observed in the given situation."

The participant must recall:

  • Heart → N
  • Star → T
  • Circle → I
  • Diamond → K
  • Triangle → H

The resulting letters are:

N – T – I – K – H

These letters are jumbled.

The participant must rearrange them to identify the word:

THINK

How to Play

  1. The symbol–letter key will be displayed on the screen for exactly 1 minute.
  2. Participants must carefully observe and memorize the letter associated with each symbol.
  3. Participants are not allowed to write down the symbol–letter combinations during the memorization period.
  4. After 1 minute, the symbol–letter key will be removed.
  5. A problem statement/case will then be provided.
  6. The problem statement will contain the names of several symbols from the memorization phase.
  7. Participants must identify the symbols mentioned in the statement.
  8. Participants must recall the corresponding letters for those symbols.
  9. The recalled letters will form a jumbled sequence.
  10. Participants must rearrange the letters and identify the meaningful word.
  11. The participant who correctly identifies the word first will be declared the winner, subject to verification by the game coordinator.
  • The symbol–letter key will be displayed only once for 1 minute.
  • Participants must rely entirely on their memory.
  • Participants are not allowed to write, photograph, screenshot, or record the displayed information.
  • Mobile phones, internet access, or any external assistance are strictly prohibited.
  • Participants must follow the symbols in the exact order in which their names appear in the problem statement.
  • All the recalled letters must be used to form the final word unless the instructions specifically state otherwise.
  • Participants must not communicate or discuss the answer with other participants.
  • Only a meaningful word that matches the intended answer will be considered correct.

Winning Criteria

  • The winner will be the first participant to correctly identify the hidden word.
  • The answer must be verified by the game coordinator before the winner is announced.
  • If the first participant gives an incorrect answer, the opportunity may be given to the next participant, subject to the organizers' decision.

Tie-Breaker

In case of a tie or simultaneous correct answers, an additional symbol–letter decoding challenge will be conducted.

The participant who correctly identifies the word in the shortest time will be declared the winner.

Disqualification

A participant may be disqualified for:

  • Taking a photograph or screenshot of the symbol–letter key.
  • Writing down the associations during the memorization period.
  • Using a mobile phone, internet, or any unauthorized aid.
  • Taking assistance from another participant.
  • Communicating the answer to another participant.
  • Attempting to view the symbol–letter key after it has been removed.
  • Using any unfair means to obtain the answer.

Final Decision

The decision of the game coordinator/judges will be final and binding in case of any dispute, ambiguity, or disagreement regarding the answer or game procedure.
